tokens.name: bg-void
tokens.usage: The darkest ground: plot canvases, the title/menu bar, heatmap gutters. Data reads best on it.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Main content area behind plots, tables and the Selected Channels strip.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars (Files, Properties, Tools, Settings), the activity rail, mode nav and playback bar.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Channel cards, floating windows (Analysis Tools, Computed Channels), menus and popovers.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Input wells: text fields, selects, number fields, the formula editor, search.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows, tabs, icon buttons and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-active
tokens.usage: Selected neutral row (a checked channel in the list), pressed secondary button.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections inside a panel. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of panels, cards, windows and file tabs.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, segmented controls and secondary buttons. 3:1+ on bg-panel, bg-raised and bg-field in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every bg-* token (15:1+; 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary text, inactive tabs, units. 7:1+ on every bg-* in every app theme.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Help text, axis ticks, placeholders, timestamps. 4.5:1+ on every bg-*; raised to 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast); never for information.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: The primary accent: primary buttons, active tab and rail item, focus ring, the playhead cursor, links, selected heatmap cell. Stealth tones it down; Ultra pushes it hotter. As text on every bg-* and cyan-soft.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind cyan text: active segment, selected rail item, info notices.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cyan fill (primary button label). 12:1.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Brand secondary, the 'Log' of the wordmark: computed-channel ƒ marks, brand highlights, the sunset signature. As text on every bg-* token and magenta-soft.

tokens.name: magenta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind magenta text (a computed channel's badge).

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text on a magenta fill (brand buttons on the website). 6.9:1.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop and syntax colour for functions in the formula editor. Not an interactive colour.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop; syntax colour for time shifts (@-0.1s, [-1]).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop; favourite stars; syntax colour for numbers in formulas.

tokens.name: redline-0
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop 0 (cyan). The 2px gradient on window tops, the welcome screen and export headers. Stealth flattens every stop to line-control.

tokens.name: redline-1
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop 1 (violet).

tokens.name: redline-2
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop 2 (magenta).

tokens.name: redline-3
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop 3 (orange).

tokens.name: redline-4
tokens.usage: Sunset signature stop 4 (gold).

tokens.name: grid-floor
tokens.usage: The perspective-grid floor drawn on the drop zone, splash and website hero. Faint at Stealth, hot magenta at Ultra.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid formula, high-confidence result, completed export. Always with a check icon or the word. Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports move it to blue, off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text in notices and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Missing optional channel, medium confidence, unsteady samples. Always with the triangle icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid formula, parse failure, destructive action. Always with the octagon icon or the word. Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports move it to vermillion-orange.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips. Lavender/violet in Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports so it never reads as success.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First selected channel (line, legend swatch, channel card strip). Series colours never change with intensity. Color-blind safe, High contrast and both export themes use the Okabe-Ito set (5:1+ on plot-bg; 3:1+ on paper).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second selected channel.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third selected channel.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth selected channel.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Fifth selected channel.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Sixth selected channel.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Seventh selected channel.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Eighth selected channel.

tokens.name: series-9
tokens.usage: Ninth channel. In Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports it repeats series-1 and MUST be drawn dashed (6/4).

tokens.name: series-10
tokens.usage: Tenth channel. In Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports it repeats series-2 and MUST be drawn dashed (6/4).

tokens.name: plot-bg
tokens.usage: Plot, scatter and track-map canvas.

tokens.name: plot-grid
tokens.usage: Minor grid lines on plot-bg.

tokens.name: plot-grid-major
tokens.usage: Major grid lines and the plot frame on plot-bg.

tokens.name: plot-axis
tokens.usage: Tick labels and axis titles on plot-bg.

tokens.name: plot-cursor
tokens.usage: The playhead line and its legend dot. Never a series colour: cyan in Night Drive, Stealth and Ultra; ink (white or black) where series-1 is blue.

tokens.name: plot-selection
tokens.usage: Drag-to-zoom and lap-range fill on plot-bg.

tokens.name: plot-legend-bg
tokens.usage: Floating legend/readout box over plot-bg (bg-panel at 90%).

tokens.name: plot-floor
tokens.usage: Perspective-grid floor inside plot canvases. Transparent everywhere except Ultra. Never in Color-blind safe, High contrast or exports.

tokens.name: seq-0
tokens.usage: Sequential colormap stop 0 (lowest). Night Drive, Stealth and Ultra use Sunset (indigo → gold). Color-blind safe, High contrast and Graphite use a cividis-style blue → yellow; Paper reverses it so low values cost the least ink.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 1.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 5.

tokens.name: seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential stop 6 (highest).

tokens.name: on-seq-0
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-0 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-1
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-1 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-2
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-2 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-3
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-3 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-4
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-4 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-5
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-5 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: on-seq-6
tokens.usage: Value text on seq-6 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible). 4.5:1+, 7:1+ in Color-blind safe and High contrast.

tokens.name: div-0
tokens.usage: Diverging map, rich end (AFR below target, negative correction). Blue in every theme.

tokens.name: div-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly rich.

tokens.name: div-2
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: on target / zero correction.

tokens.name: div-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly lean.

tokens.name: div-4
tokens.usage: Diverging, lean end (AFR above target, positive correction). Orange in every theme.

tokens.name: on-div-0
tokens.usage: Value text on div-0 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible).

tokens.name: on-div-1
tokens.usage: Value text on div-1 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible).

tokens.name: on-div-2
tokens.usage: Value text on div-2 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible).

tokens.name: on-div-3
tokens.usage: Value text on div-3 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible).

tokens.name: on-div-4
tokens.usage: Value text on div-4 (on top of cell-plate where the plate is visible).

tokens.name: cell-empty
tokens.usage: Heatmap/table cells with no samples. Draw with the 45° hatch so empty never reads as a low value.

tokens.name: cell-plate
tokens.usage: A solid plate behind each cell value. Transparent in Night Drive, Stealth, Ultra and Paper; visible in Color-blind safe, High contrast and Graphite so every value reaches 7:1 whatever the cell colour.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Saira carries the motorsport voice: italic heavy for brand moments, upright semibold for titles and the mode nav.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website hero, splash and welcome screen only. One per view.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Website section titles, empty-state headlines, release notes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and window titles (Files, Properties, Analysis Tools).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase. Mode nav items, group headers in lists, table axis titles.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Outfit stays the workhorse it already is in the app.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Collapsible section headers inside panels, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Standardize channel names across ECU types.
styles.usage: Default UI text, list rows, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button labels, tab labels, channel names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text under controls, metadata, notes. ink-subtle or ink-muted.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Every number a tuner compares is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, so columns and changing readouts never jitter.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Channel card min/max, playback time, the big readout of a selected cell.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Legend values, table cells, formulas, file stats.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Axis ticks, cell event counts, supported-format lists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding, gap between segmented items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, list-row vertical padding, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between channel cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between form rows groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections, window body padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing, website block gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website section rhythm; activity rail width.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Heatmap cells, count badges, legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, segmented items, file tabs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, channel cards, list rows, rail buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating windows, drop zone, website cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Slider track and thumb only.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly ground steps and borders. Glows and bloom are the dials the Ultra intensity setting turns.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Floating windows, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a ground-coloured gap then a solid cyan ring (5px in High contrast).

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Hover on the primary button and the active mode-nav bar. Scales with Ultra intensity: none at Stealth, wide at Ultra.

tokens.name: glow-magenta
tokens.usage: Brand moments on the website and splash. Scales with intensity.

tokens.name: bloom-series
tokens.usage: CSS drop-shadow arguments for series lines (colour = the line). 0 at Night Drive and below; 4px at Ultra. Always 0 in Color-blind safe, High contrast and exports.

stroke.note: Line weights for chrome and data.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, borders, grid lines.

tokens.name: stroke-indicator
tokens.usage: Active tab underline, rail indicator, selected cell outline, signature redline.

tokens.name: stroke-series
tokens.usage: Series lines in plots (2px for a hovered or soloed series).

tokens.name: stroke-cursor
tokens.usage: The playhead cursor line.
